skill.name: wan-3-0-prime-reference-to-video
skill.description: Generate 2-30 second Wan 3.0 Prime videos from numbered image, video, and audio references through the RunComfy CLI. Configure resolution, aspect ratio, audio, prompt extension, duration, and seed.
skill.summary: Create consistent reference-guided video clips with Wan 3.0 Prime on RunComfy.
skill.author: genmedia-labs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, placeholder URLs, and ellipses. Confirmed behavior includes local CLI execution, unpinned package installation, third-party media processing, and paid remote generation.

remediation.issue: The setup recommends globally installing or executing an unpinned npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited RunComfy CLI version and avoid automatic global installation during skill execution.

remediation.issue: Prompts and approved reference URLs are submitted to RunComfy for remote processing.
remediation.suggestion: Request consent before transmission and warn users not to submit confidential or unlicensed media.

remediation.issue: Each generation request can create usage charges based on output and reference-video duration.
remediation.suggestion: Show the estimated counted seconds and price, then obtain explicit confirmation before submission.

content.user_title: Create Reference-Guided Videos with Wan 3.0 Prime
content.value_statement: Consistent characters, products, and scenes are difficult to maintain across generated video. This skill builds structured Wan 3.0 Prime requests from numbered references.
actual_capabilities: Builds prompts that address image, video, and audio references by array order.
Supports up to 10 images, 5 videos, and 5 audio clips within documented duration limits.
Configures 480p, 720p, or 1080p output across six supported aspect ratios.
Controls duration, prompt extension, synchronized audio, and reproducible seed values.
Invokes the Wan 3.0 Prime reference-to-video endpoint through the RunComfy CLI.
Explains counted-second pricing before remote generation.
limitations: Each generated clip must be between 2 and 30 seconds.
Reference videos and audio each have a combined 15-second limit.
At least one image, video, or audio reference is required.
Remote generation requires a RunComfy account, network access, and paid usage.

use_cases.title: Maintain Character Identity
use_cases.description: Generate short scenes while preserving a character's face, clothing, and visual identity from approved references.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Motion
use_cases.description: Turn product photographs into controlled marketing shots with specified camera movement, lighting, and framing.

use_cases.title: Build Multimodal Social Clips
use_cases.description: Combine visual, motion, and rhythm references into vertical video with repeatable settings.

prompt_templates.title: Animate One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second video from Image 1. Show [single action] with [camera movement], [lighting], and [mood]. Use [resolution] and [aspect ratio].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Image 1 as the exact product reference. Show [product motion] in [setting]. Render a short 480p draft with prompt extension disabled.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Character and Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Image 1 defines the character and Image 2 defines the wardrobe. Follow the movement from Video 1 while the camera performs [camera direction].

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Reproducible Final
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [duration]-second [aspect ratio] final at 1080p. Bind each numbered reference to its role, match Audio 1 timing, and reuse seed [seed].

output_examples.input: Create a five-second botanical garden shot from one portrait reference at 720p.
output_examples.output: A RunComfy generation request using Image 1 for identity, a slow walking action, gentle camera motion, and synchronized audio.

output_examples.input: Draft a vertical perfume video before producing the final version.
output: Draft: three seconds at 480p with literal prompt handling.
Final: approved motion at 1080p, vertical framing, and a reused seed.

output_examples.input: Combine an actor image, wardrobe image, street video, and rhythm track.
output_examples.output: A numbered multimodal request that assigns identity, clothing, motion, and timing roles while respecting reference limits.

best_practices: Name every reference by its array position and state one clear role for each.
Draft at 480p for two to five seconds before increasing duration or resolution.
Trim reference videos because their duration increases the billed counted seconds.
anti_patterns: Do not call this endpoint without at least one approved reference.
Do not combine reference videos exceeding 15 seconds in total.
Do not submit confidential, unlicensed, or unapproved media to the remote service.

faq.question: What reference types can I use?
faq.answer: You can use images, MP4 or MOV videos, and audio clips through publicly fetchable HTTPS URLs.

faq.question: How are references named in prompts?
faq.answer: Use Image 1, Video 1, or Audio 1 according to each item's position in its array.

faq.question: How long can the output be?
faq.answer: The endpoint supports whole-second durations from 2 through 30 seconds.

faq.question: How is generation priced?
faq.answer: Billing counts output duration plus the combined duration of reference videos. Resolution determines the rate.

faq.question: Can it generate without reference media?
faq.answer: No. Use a text-to-video model when no image, video, or audio reference is available.

faq.question: Where are generated files stored?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads approved output URLs into the selected local output directory.
